headline: Healthcare AI vendors face new revenue model questions amid automation surge
body: Robot tipping mechanisms are entering public discourse as automation becomes more visible in consumer-facing services, raising questions about economic incentives in AI-driven workflows. For healthcare AI specifically, this signals growing attention to how revenue flows through automated systems and who captures value when AI handles clinical tasks. Healthcare organizations implementing AI for documentation, coding, or patient engagement need clarity on vendor compensation models and whether automation economics align with their value-based care arrangements. As vendors like DarioHealth expand health plan partnerships covering millions of lives, the underlying payment structures for AI-assisted workflows will increasingly influence adoption decisions and care delivery ROI.
